classification.difficultyReason: Follow directed arrows to fill dependent nodes, then compare source and destination monomials to infer missing multiplication or division operations.

answer.short:
Empty ovals, from top to bottom and left to right: $16p^2$, $4p^2$, $p$, $2p^2$, $p$, $3p$.

Missing arrow operations: $2p\to2p^2$: $\times p$; $2p^2\to16p^3$: $\times8p$; $16p^2\to16p^3$: $\times p$; $16p^2\to8p^2$: $\div2$; $16p^3\to4p^2$: $\div(4p)$; $p^2\to p$: $\div p$; $4p^2\to12p^2$: $\times3$; $3p\to12p^2$: $\times4p$.
answer.worked:
Empty ovals:
$$\begin{align*}2p^2\times8&=16p^2\\2p\times2p&=4p^2\\\frac{4p^2}{4p}&=p\\p\times2p&=2p^2\\\frac{8p^2}{8p}&=p\\p\times3&=3p\end{align*}$$
Missing arrow operations:
$$\begin{align*}2p\times p&=2p^2\\2p^2\times8p&=16p^3\\16p^2\times p&=16p^3\\\frac{16p^2}{2}&=8p^2\\\frac{16p^3}{4p}&=4p^2\\\frac{p^2}{p}&=p\\4p^2\times3&=12p^2\\3p\times4p&=12p^2\end{align*}$$
